journeys.title: ODC1 / BABS research discovery journey
journeys.intended_user: Patient-group organizer or rare-disease research coordinator
journeys.plain_language: Start from Bachmann-Bupp syndrome, follow C-terminal gain-of-function biology (not loss-of-function), connect to GeneReviews/NORD evidence, then to ICPD investigational DFMO research and a next question that keeps LoF and cancer contexts separate. No approval or treatment recommendation is asserted.

answers.next_step: Verify current ICPD compassionate-use DFMO public information and keep LoF/cancer claims labeled unresolved/separate in any collaboration brief.
